headline: Aspire is moving beyond payments with AspireBooks for AI accounting
body: Aspire is moving beyond business payments with AspireBooks, an AI accounting service that classifies transactions and matches payments with invoices and bills. It is available to businesses in Singapore for S$39 per month, with a three-month free introductory period. Aspire's internal research found that 41 percent of its customers still manage bookkeeping manually.
note: Aspire's CEO says the goal is accounting that happens as a natural part of running a business. Users still review and approve the entries, and the reports update as transactions are recorded.

figure.label: Aspire customers still doing bookkeeping manually

evidence.text: Aspire is moving beyond business payments with a new AI-powered accounting platform that automates bookkeeping and reconciliation.
The AspireBooks service uses AI to classify transactions, recommend accounting categories and tax treatments, and match payments with invoices and bills.
Aspire's internal research found that 41 percent of its customers still manage bookkeeping manually.
AspireBooks is available to businesses in Singapore for S$39 per month, with a three-month free introductory period.
Users can then review and approve the entries, while financial reports such as profit and loss statements, balance sheets and trial balances are updated as transactions are recorded.
With AspireBooks, we're bringing these two worlds together so accounting happens as a natural part of running a business, rather than becoming a separate exercise at the end of every month.
said Andrea Baronchelli, Co-founder and CEO of Aspire.
